title: Concept: Hibernate SQL echoed in a response
description: A Hibernate SQL statement echoed into the page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The echo prints the generated SQL with its bind parameters, which reveals the schema, the column names and sometimes the values of other users' rows.
applicability: Deployments that render a Hibernate SQL statement echoed into the page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The echo prints the generated SQL with its bind parameters, which reveals the schema, the column names and sometimes the values of other users' rows.
